description: The Town of Oakville resource lists active building permits as point locations. CUDC descriptors provide CSV, shapefile, GeoJSON and KML representations. The metadata identifies 9,381 rows and 15 columns in a saved snapshot, with native dates from October 2000 to July 2024. These are source metadata counts and dates, not a freshly queried feature total or proof that all permits remain active. Fields other than permit locations are not established. Permits indicate an administrative construction state and do not establish completed buildings or occupancy. The original municipal portal is retained with the exact CUDC record; no feature query or exported geometry was downloaded. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Town of Oakville. Licence: Town of Oakville Open Data License. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says Open; isopen is false. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities.
